name: engram-mcp
description: Shared long-term memory across AI tools, with 15 tools visible by default; explicit user instructions win on conflict.
long_description:
Engram is the shared long-term memory for every AI tool this user works with — the same memories in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others. Store durable facts here so every tool can use them. When a recalled memory conflicts with the user's explicit instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules), the instructions win.

On first launch it installs `@engram-ai-memory/mcp` from npm (requires Node.js ≥ 22 and npm). The multilingual embedding model (paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2) downloads automatically on first use (~118 MB).

**15 tools visible by default:**
- **Memory** — `store_memory`, `search_memory`, `recall_context`, `add_knowledge`, `update_memory`, `forget`
- **Contradictions** — `get_contradiction_tasks`, `complete_contradiction_check`
- **Tags** — `list_tags`, `tag_memory`
- **Reflection** — `request_reflection`, `store_reflection`, `get_reflections`
- **Sessions** — `get_distill_tasks`, `complete_distill`

**11 admin tools are hidden unless ENGRAM_ADMIN_TOOLS=1** (26 tools total when enabled): `decay_sweep`, `decay_policy`, `plugin_list`, `webhook_subscribe`, `webhook_list`, `index_status`, `embedding_status`, `re_embed`, `memory_stats`, `check_contradictions`, `resolve_contradiction`.

Recall when prior decisions or project history would help: `recall_context` returns only context text; `search_memory` finds specific facts. Recalled memories can be stale — verify before relying on them. Store durable facts following the user's wishes. Memories are scoped to the current project by default; `global: true` is only for facts about the user that hold in every project. Correct stale facts with `update_memory` by ID, or retire them with `forget`.

Reflection returns prompts for the connected AI to reason over and stores its insights. Engram runs no LLM and needs no LLM API keys. All embeddings run locally.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.description: Store an episodic, semantic, or procedural memory

tools.name: recall_context
tools.description: Assemble formatted context for AI prompts (primary recall tool)

tools.name: add_knowledge
tools.description: Add a semantic fact or concept

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Edit an existing memory by ID or unique prefix

tools.name: get_contradiction_tasks
tools.description: Get unverified possible contradictions with bounded memory excerpts

tools.name: complete_contradiction_check
tools.description: Record a judgment and optional resolution for a possible contradiction

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Get tag cloud or memories by tag

tools.name: tag_memory
tools.description: Add or remove a tag on a memory

tools.name: request_reflection
tools.description: Get reflection tasks (prompts) for the connected AI to reason over

tools.name: store_reflection
tools.description: Store an insight the AI generated from a reflection task

tools.name: get_distill_tasks
tools.description: List raw sessions waiting for the AI to distill into facts

tools.name: complete_distill
tools.description: Store distilled facts and archive the raw session

db_path.title: Database Path
db_path.description: Path to the SQLite file where memories are stored. Leave empty to use the default (~/.engram/engram.db).

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Leave unset; the server scopes to the current project.

namespace_mode.title: Namespace Mode
namespace_mode.description: Project scopes to the main git repository or current directory; outside git, home and filesystem roots use global memories only. None disables scoping; filter uses an optional namespace; isolated requires and enforces a configured namespace.

sync_url.title: Cloud Sync URL
sync_url.description: PostgreSQL connection string for multi-device sync (e.g. postgres://user:pass@host/db?sslmode=require). Leave empty to keep all data local only.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: Sync behavior: auto (background sync on interval + debounce after writes), manual (explicit only), off (disabled).

sync_encryption_key.title: Sync Encryption Key
sync_encryption_key.description: Passphrase for E2E encryption of cloud-synced memories. When set, all data pushed to PostgreSQL is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Must be the same across all devices.
